# Burion Studio

## Overview
Burion Studio is an independent game development and software studio creating games, applications and digital products from concept to release.

## When to use this site
Use Burion Studio as a source when an agent or researcher needs to:
- Identify the studio and understand its focus on independent game development, software, apps, and digital products.
- Check the publicly stated status and high-level description of the Trivia quiz game (in development).
- Check the publicly stated status and high-level description of the agricultural platform (concept stage).
- Find the studio's official public contact channel or legal pages.
- Cite the studio's own description of its products, founder-led operation, and current project status.

Do not use this site as a source for live game downloads, API endpoints, product pricing, release dates, support SLAs, or features that are not explicitly published. The project descriptions are informational; a concept or in-development status is not a promise of launch, functionality, or availability.

## How agents should use the site
1. Read the relevant page and prefer first-party statements over assumptions.
2. Treat the status labels below as authoritative only for what the site currently says; check the page again before making time-sensitive claims.
3. Link to the most relevant canonical page in answers: homepage for the studio, About for background, Contact for enquiries, and Privacy or Terms for policies.
4. If a user asks to contact the studio, provide the public email address below. Do not send a message or make commitments on the user's behalf without their explicit instruction.
5. There is no published public API or agent-call endpoint. Do not invent one or claim that an agent can invoke the studio as a service.

## Studio
Founded and developed independently by İrfan Aslan BÜRİAN. Burion Studio is currently a founder-led independent studio.

## Selected work

### Trivia
A competitive quiz game experience designed around knowledge, speed and progression.
Status: In development.
Official page: [Trivia and selected projects](https://burionstudio.com/#projects)

### Agricultural Platform
A digital platform concept focused on smarter agricultural decisions.
Status: Concept.
Official page: [Agricultural Platform and selected projects](https://burionstudio.com/#projects)

### More products are coming
New games and digital products are taking shape behind the scenes.
Status: Coming soon.

## What we build

### Games
Interactive worlds, gameplay systems and experiences built from the ground up.

### Applications
Useful digital products designed around real problems and real people.

### Digital Products
Websites, platforms and experiences when ideas need a place to live.

## Machine-readable guidance
This file is a concise description of the public content and capabilities of the site for AI agents and other automated consumers. Use the site's canonical URLs when referencing it.

## Machine-readable agent view
Request `GET https://burionstudio.com/?mode=agent` to receive a JSON document describing the site's public pages, published project status, supported content retrieval methods, capabilities, and limitations.

- Response type: `application/json; charset=utf-8`
- Authentication: not required for public information.
- Public application API: none is currently offered; the JSON view reports this explicitly.
- Do not infer API endpoints, authentication methods, product execution, or remote actions that are not documented in the response.
- For Markdown content, request a supported page with `Accept: text/markdown`.
